title: Playing at Larry's art gallery; the arrest
summary: Punch describes the pay and tip sharing at Larry's gallery and the night police arrested the band and the judge dropped it.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Let's see, you remember where we left off? I think we were just talking about things in general. Yeah. So let's get back to what happened at Larry's now. You used to work there in the art gallery, huh? Yeah.
Yeah. How did that work now?

Well that worked out nice, we got a little light salary, but the tips was the main thing. And we made real good tips there. Real good tips. And uh, there's a little funny thing about it. This is something I had to get after, but I got to tell it. See when I had the white boys there waiting with me, well they didn't want any money. All the money went to me. All the tips went to me. But when I got to the place where I had to use the other boys, well then I had to start splitting up you know. So that made it much different. Made it much different. And about going to jail, well that was one of them nights the giant was jumping. I mean it was packing jamming. The policeman walked in, told us to quit playing. We quit playing and told us to come on outside, went on outside and took us on down. But it wasn't nothing to it. There was me coaching the next day. And it was all over with, because that judge did some talking there.
But they just dropped everything after the talking. Yeah.
There was no more to it after. And that was when you sang that song the next night.
